import math

x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
diff_min = 1e9
a_num = 0
a_den = 0

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    lcm = y * i // math.gcd(int(y), i)
    ip = int(x * (lcm // y))
    if ip % (lcm // i) == 0:
        ip //= (lcm // i)
    else:
        val = float(ip)
        denom = float(lcm // i)
        val = (val / denom) + 0.49
        ip = int(val)
    ip_dbl = float(ip)
    if diff_min > abs(x / y - ip_dbl / float(i)):
        diff_min = abs(x / y - ip_dbl / float(i))
        a_num = ip_dbl
        a_den = i

g = math.gcd(int(a_num), a_den)
a_num = int(a_num) // g
a_den = a_den // g

print(f"{a_num}/{a_den}")
